docs.title: Bizneo Integration Overview in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Bizneo integration connects Omne RH Payroll with Bizneo HCM and Bizneo ATS. It supports the daily flow of employees, documents, contracts, and the return path from Bizneo into Omne RH through the integrated employee staging tables.

docs.title: What this integration covers
docs.text:
• Create or update employees in Bizneo from Omne RH
  • Import employees from Bizneo back into Omne RH as payroll employees
  • Send payroll documents and HR documents to Bizneo
  • Synchronize contracts and document metadata
  • Review integration logs and job queue runs

docs.title: Main business flow
docs.text:
1. A payroll employee is copied into Employee Integrations.
  2. The integration sends the employee to Bizneo when the configured mode allows it.
  3. Bizneo returns identifiers and status updates for the employee and related contracts.
  4. Imported data is applied back to payroll employees and their auxiliary records when needed.

docs.title: Who uses this module
docs.text: Role Main use Payroll administrator Review employee synchronization and send manual updates HR manager Manage employee data, documents, and returned employee records Functional consultant Configure integration modes and troubleshoot Bizneo behavior

docs.title: Payroll employee
docs.text: The payroll employee is the master employee record in Omne RH. It is the source of truth for most employee data.

docs.title: Employee Integrations
docs.text: This is the staging area used by the Bizneo integration. It stores employees before they are sent to Bizneo and also stores records received from Bizneo before they are imported into payroll.

docs.title: Perceptor transfer
docs.text: The preferred flow is to transfer a payroll employee into Employee Integrations instead of creating an integrated employee manually. That preserves the link with the payroll employee and keeps the synchronization traceable.

docs.title: Auxiliary data
docs.text: When Bizneo data is imported back into Omne RH, the system can also complete auxiliary records such as additional employee information, income tax data, and bank data.

docs.title: Bizneo FAQ in Omne RH Payroll
Do I need to transfer the employee from the payroll list?
docs.text: Yes. That is the recommended path when the person already exists as a payroll employee because it keeps the link between the payroll record and the integrated employee.

docs.title: Can I create an integrated employee manually?
docs.text: Yes, but only when the person does not yet exist as a payroll employee. Manual creation should be the exception, not the standard flow.

docs.title: What happens when Bizneo sends data back to Omne RH?
docs.text: The system imports the employee into the integrated employee staging area and then completes the payroll employee and its auxiliary records.

docs.title: Which auxiliary records can be updated during import?
docs.text: Depending on the data received, the import can update additional employee information, income tax data, and bank data.

docs.title: Why does an employee not reach Bizneo?
docs.text: Usually because the employee is missing required data, the portal integration is disabled, or the Bizneo integration mode is not set to automatic.

docs.title: How do I know if a document reached Bizneo?
docs.text: Check the integration log and verify that the document received a Bizneo identifier.

docs.title: Import Employees from Bizneo in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this task when Bizneo sends employee data back to Omne RH, for example from Bizneo ATS or when HR updates data in the portal.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The employee record already exists in Employee Integrations.
  • The record contains data received from Bizneo.
  • The user has permission to import employee data.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Employee Integrations", and open the list.
  2. Select the employee record received from Bizneo.
  3. Choose Import Data.
  4. Review the resulting payroll employee record.
  5. Confirm that the auxiliary employee records were completed.

docs.title: What the import updates
docs.text:
The import process can update more than just the main payroll employee record:

Area Typical result Payroll employee Creates or updates the employee master record Additional information Completes extra employee data Income tax Updates income tax details Bank data Creates or updates the employee bank record

docs.title: Why this matters
docs.text: Bizneo should not leave the employee in an incomplete state inside Omne RH. The import process finishes the record so HR and payroll users do not need to retype data that already came from Bizneo.

docs.text:

  • Bizneo Troubleshooting

docs.title: Send Documents to Bizneo in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this task when you want to publish payroll or HR documents in Bizneo so employees can access them in their portal.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The employee exists in Employee Integrations.
  • The employee has a valid Bizneo identifier.
  • The document is available in the HR documents area.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "HR Documents", and open the list.
  2. Select the document you want to send.
  3. Choose Bizneo Integration > Send Document to Bizneo.
  4. Review the integration log.
  5. Confirm that Bizneo returned a document identifier.

docs.title: What happens after sending
docs.text:
• The document is uploaded to Bizneo.
  • The integration stores the Bizneo document identifier.
  • The document remains traceable from Omne RH.

docs.title: Common document checks
docs.text: Check Expected result Employee reference The document is linked to a valid employee File content The document contains an attached file Integration log The log shows the action and the result

docs.title: Set Up Bizneo Integration in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Before you use Bizneo, configure the connection, the integration modes, and the employee transfer behavior.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The Bizneo API URL and token are available.
  • You have access to the Bizneo site configuration.
  • Employee transfer rules are defined for the company.
  • The employee master data is complete enough to be synchronized.

docs.title: Step 1: Configure the Bizneo site connection
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Sites" or "Telematic Sites", and choose the related link used in your environment.
  2. Find the record for Bizneo.
  3. Enter the API URL and the authentication token provided by Bizneo.
  4. Save the record.

docs.title: Step 2: Configure portal integration modes
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Portal Integration Settings", and choose the related link.
  2. Create the Bizneo configuration if it does not already exist.
  3. Set the provider to BizneoHCM or BizneoATS depending on the use case.
  4. Set the data type to Portal Employee, Absences, or Selection as needed.
  5. Choose the integration mode for output and input.
  6. Mark the configuration as active.

docs.title: Step 3: Decide how employees will enter Bizneo
docs.text:
The preferred method is to transfer payroll employees into Employee Integrations from the payroll employee list.

Option Result Transfer from payroll employee list Keeps the payroll link and sets the integration metadata correctly Create the integrated employee manually Only use this when the person does not yet exist as a payroll employee

docs.title: Step 4: Verify the setup
docs.text:
1. Confirm that at least one active Bizneo configuration exists.
  2. Confirm that the Bizneo site record contains a valid URL and token.
  3. Confirm that employees can be transferred into Employee Integrations.
  4. Confirm that the integration log records each execution.

docs.text:
• Bizneo Integration Overview
  • Transfer Employees to Bizneo

docs.title: Transfer Employees to Bizneo in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this task when an employee already exists in Omne RH Payroll and you want to send that employee to Bizneo. This is the recommended path because it preserves the payroll employee link.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The employee exists in the payroll employee list.
  • The employee has first name, first surname, second surname, document, and at least one email.
  • The employee is marked for portal integration.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Employees", and open the payroll employee list.
  2. Select one or more employees.
  3. Choose Portal > Employee Integrations.
  4. Choose Transfer Selected or Transfer All Filtered.
  5. Open Employee Integrations and verify that the new records were created.

docs.title: What happens after the transfer
docs.text:
• The integration links the integrated employee to the payroll employee.
  • The source is set to BC.
  • The record is prepared for the Bizneo outbound flow.
  • The system keeps the employee ready for future updates.

docs.title: Important checks
docs.text: Check Expected result Payroll employee link The integrated record stays tied to the payroll employee Company The company field is filled Email At least one usable email exists Portal integration The employee is allowed to participate in portal integration

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Set Up Bizneo Integration
  • Bizneo FAQ

docs.title: Troubleshooting Bizneo Integration in Omne RH Payroll
An employee is not sent to Bizneo
docs.text:
If the employee does not reach Bizneo, check these items:

  1. The employee is marked for portal integration.
  2. The Bizneo configuration is active.
  3. The integration mode allows outbound synchronization.
  4. The employee has the required name, document, company, and email data.

docs.title: Authentication fails
docs.text: If the integration returns an authentication error, verify the Bizneo URL and token in the Bizneo site configuration.

docs.title: The employee comes back from Bizneo but the payroll record looks incomplete
docs.text: The import must complete the payroll employee and its auxiliary records. If it stops early, review the integration log and rerun the import from Employee Integrations.

docs.title: Contracts do not keep their Bizneo identifier
docs.text: Check that the contract has a start date and belongs to the same employee record that Bizneo returned. If multiple contracts share the same start date, only the first matching record may be updated automatically.

docs.title: Documents do not appear in Bizneo
docs.text: Check that the document is linked to a valid employee, has an attached file, and was sent from the HR documents area or the employee integration actions.

docs.title: When to escalate to support
docs.text:
Escalate the issue when:

  • The token is correct but Bizneo still returns HTTP 401 or 403.
  • The same document or employee fails repeatedly after cleanup.
  • The integration log shows a server-side Bizneo error that does not clear after retry.

docs.title: Contracts Overview in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: The Contracts module in Omne RH Payroll manages the complete lifecycle of employment contracts: creation, maintenance, extensions, termination, and integration with external systems such as SEPE (NetContrata) and the Social Security RED System.

docs.title: Key concepts
docs.text:
• Contract key: A 3-character code that identifies the contract type according to current legislation (for example, "100" for permanent ordinary, "401" for temporary work or service). Each key defines legal conditions such as minimum and maximum duration, social security contribution rates, and whether the contract qualifies for subsidies.

  • Extension (Prórroga): A renewal of a temporary contract. Each extension creates a new linked record with its own start date, duration, and end date. The system validates that total duration does not exceed the legal maximum for the contract type.

  • Subsidy (Bonificación): A reduction of employer social security contributions linked to the employee's group (age, disability, unemployed status) and the contract type. Subsidies can have time-based tiers with different percentages.

  • Substitution: A contract created to cover the temporary absence of another worker (sick leave, maternity, leave of absence). The substitute contract records the replaced employee and the substitution cause.

  • Successive contract: A chain of contracts for the same employee where each contract starts the day after the previous one ends. The system detects these automatically to calculate seniority correctly.

docs.title: What you can do
docs.text:
• Create and manage employment contracts with automatic validation of legal limits
  • Extend temporary contracts with duration validation
  • Terminate contracts with automatic calculation of pending vacation days
  • Process bulk contract changes from Excel files
  • Assign and manage employer subsidies
  • Generate AFI movements for Social Security communication
  • Register contracts and extensions with SEPE via NetContrata
  • Run reports for contract listings, upcoming expirations, and substitutions

docs.title: Assign Subsidies to a Contract in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure when a contract qualifies for employer social security contribution reductions based on the worker's group (age, disability, long-term unemployed) or the contract type characteristics.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The contract type must support subsidies
  • If the subsidy depends on the worker's group, the employee data must reflect the condition (age, disability degree, unemployed status)

docs.title: Individual assignment
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Select the contract to which you want to assign a subsidy.
  3. Choose Subsidy from the navigation bar.
  4. Choose New in the subsidy list.
  5. In the Subsidy Code field, enter the corresponding code.
  6. In the Grant Date field, enter the date from which the subsidy applies.
  7. If the subsidy has a known end date, fill in the Loss Date field.
  8. Choose Save.

docs.title: Bulk assignment
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Choose Bulk Subsidies from the action bar (Process section).
  3. In the request page:
  4. Select Action: "Create" for new subsidies
  5. In the Subsidy Code field, enter the code to assign
  6. In the Start Date field, enter the subsidy period start
  7. Optionally fill the End Date field
  8. Enable Absorb Excess if applicable
  9. Apply filters for employees or contribution units.
  10. Choose OK.
  11. The system creates subsidies for all qualifying contracts and marks them as Subsidized = Yes.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The selected contracts are marked as Subsidized = Yes and have subsidy records with correct dates and codes.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution Non-subsidized contract Accessing subsidies on a contract not marked as subsidized Enable the Subsidized field on the contract card first, or assign a contract key that has subsidies configured Incompatible group code The subsidy group does not match the employee data (age, sex, disability) Verify the employee personal data and select a compatible group

docs.title: Create an Employment Contract in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure when a new worker joins the company or when an existing worker signs a new contract. A contract is required before the employee can be included in payroll calculation.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The employee (perceptor) is registered with ID number, name, contribution unit, and labor agreement
  • The contract type catalog contains the key for the new contract
  • The labor agreement has active categories

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Choose New to create a record.
  3. In the Employee No. field, enter the worker code.
  4. The system loads the employee data automatically: name, ID, social security number, contribution unit, labor agreement, and contribution group.
  5. In the Contract Key field, enter the contract type code (for example, "100" for permanent ordinary).
  6. The system loads the type description, duration limits, and subsidy parameters.
  7. In the Start Date field, enter the contract start date.
  8. The system recalculates seniority and carries forward pending garnishments from prior contracts if applicable.
  9. For temporary contracts, in the Duration field, enter the contract length (for example, "1Y" for one year).
  10. The system calculates the End Date automatically and validates it against the type limits.
  11. In the Category field, select the professional category from the labor agreement.
  12. Configure the working schedule:
  13. Hours per Day: daily working hours
  14. Hours per Week: weekly working hours
  15. Days per Week: working days per week
  16. Schedule Type: select Semanal (Weekly), Anual (Annual), Diaria (Daily), or Mensual (Monthly)
  17. Choose Save.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The contract appears in the list with active status (the Terminated and Company Leave fields are empty). The employee's data is updated with the contract information.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution Contract key cannot be empty Saved without entering a contract key Fill in the Contract Key field before saving End date before start date Duration results in an end date before the start Review the start date and duration values Payrolls exist after the start date Changing start date when payrolls already calculated Cancel affected payrolls before modifying the date

docs.title: Extend a Temporary Contract in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure when a temporary contract must be extended beyond its original end date. The extension creates a new contractual period linked to the original contract and validates that total duration does not exceed the legal maximum.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The contract is temporary (has an End Date and is not permanent type)
  • The contract is not terminated (Terminated = No)
  • The contract is not already extended (Extended = No)

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Select the contract you want to extend.
  3. Choose Extensions from the navigation bar.
  4. Choose New to create an extension.
  5. The system assigns the Extension No. automatically.
  6. The Extension Start field is calculated as the day after the end date of the previous extension (or the original contract if this is the first extension).
  7. In the Duration field, enter the extension length (for example, "6M" for 6 months).
  8. The system calculates the End Date of the extension.
  9. If the resulting date exceeds the maximum duration for the contract type, the system shows an error.
  10. Choose Save.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The extension appears in the list linked to the contract. The original contract is marked as Extended = Yes. The employee's end date is updated with the new extension end date.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution This contract cannot be extended The contract is terminated or already extended Verify Terminated = No and Extended = No on the base contract Duration exceeds maximum The extension would make total duration exceed the Maximum Time of the contract type Reduce the extension duration or check the contract type settings Extensions must be deleted in reverse order Attempted to delete an intermediate extension Delete the last extension first, then proceed in reverse order

docs.title: Contracts FAQ in Omne RH Payroll
What is the difference between Terminated and Company Leave?
docs.text:
Company Leave is a date field indicating when the worker left the company. When you fill this field, the system automatically sets Terminated = Yes. However, Terminated can also be set when an extension is finalized and propagates its status to the base contract.

Key difference: - Company Leave with a date means the worker has ceased employment and pending vacation days are calculated - Terminated without Company Leave means the contract was closed administratively (the worker may have another active contract)

To generate an AFI leave movement, both Company Leave and Leave Cause Code must be filled.

docs.title: Can I change the contract key after creating extensions?
docs.text:
No. Once a contract has linked extensions, the system blocks modification of the Contract Key field because extensions inherit duration rules from the original contract type.

To change the contract key: 1. Delete all extensions in reverse order (last to first) 2. Modify the Contract Key 3. Recreate extensions if still needed

docs.title: How does the system handle garnishments with successive contracts?
docs.text: When a new contract starts the day after the previous one ends (successive contract), the system does not automatically intervene with garnishments. If there is a gap between contracts, the system detects pending withholding movements from the prior contract and offers to carry them forward to the new contract.

docs.title: What happens with vacation when a temporary contract lasts less than 11 months?
docs.text: The Prorated Vacation field activates automatically for temporary contracts shorter than 11 months. In these cases, vacation is calculated proportionally to time worked and included as a severance concept at termination, rather than taken as time off.

docs.title: How is seniority calculated with successive contracts?
docs.text:
When the system detects a chain of successive contracts (same employee, same contract key, each starting the day after the previous ends), it traces back to the original contract. Seniority is calculated from the start date of that first contract.

This affects: - Pending vacation day calculations - Seniority-based pay supplements - Severance compensation rights

docs.title: Can I delete a contract that has calculated payrolls?
docs.text:
No. The system prevents deletion of contracts when calculated payrolls exist for the employee in the contract period. You must cancel all associated payrolls before deleting the contract.

The same restriction applies to modifying the Start Date or End Date when payrolls exist in the affected dates.

docs.title: What do the Integrated Contracts statuses mean?
docs.text:
Status Meaning Action Pending Generated but not yet sent to the external system Verify data and trigger the send Sent Successfully sent to the external system None needed Send Error An error occurred during send or processing Review contract data, correct, and retry

The Integrated Contracts page is read-only. Corrections must be made on the original contract and resent.

docs.title: How does the Subsidy Group Code affect subsidies?
docs.text:
The subsidy group code classifies the worker by characteristics (age, sex, disability degree, unemployed status) to determine the applicable subsidy. The system cross-validates: - If the group requires a minimum age, it checks against the employee's birth date - If it requires a specific sex, it checks the employee's sex - If it requires a disability degree, it verifies the registered degree

An incompatible group code generates a validation error when saving.

docs.title: Generate AFI Movements for Social Security in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure to communicate contract registrations, leaves, and variations to Social Security through the RED System. The process creates affiliation movements that are later transmitted in the AFI file.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The contract has complete affiliation data (employee social security number, regime, contribution unit CCC)
  • For AFI leave: the contract must have the Company Leave and Leave Cause Code fields filled in

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Select one or more contracts.
  3. In the action bar, under the Social Security Affiliation section:
  4. For a registration: choose Create AFI Registration.
    • The system generates a registration movement (code 1).
  5. For a leave: choose Create AFI Leave.
    • The system validates that Company Leave and Leave Cause Code are filled.
    • The system generates a leave movement (code 2).
  6. For a variation: choose Create AFI Variation.
    • The system generates a variation movement and opens the affiliation list.
  7. To review generated movements, choose RED System Affiliation File to open the employee's affiliation list.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: An affiliation movement is created and visible in the employee's affiliation list, ready to be sent to the Social Security RED System.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution Company leave date required for AFI leave The Company Leave field is empty Enter the leave date on the contract card first Leave cause code required for AFI leave The Leave Cause Code field is empty Enter the leave cause code before generating AFI leave

docs.text:

docs.title: Manage Contract Substitutions in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure when you hire a temporary worker to cover another worker's absence (sick leave, maternity, leave of absence). The substitution contract is linked to the replaced employee and the cause of the substitution.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The replaced employee's contract exists
  • The absence incident for the replaced employee is recorded (sick leave, maternity, etc.)

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Create a new contract for the substitute worker following the standard Create a contract procedure.
  3. On the contract card, fill in:
  4. Replaced Employee No.: the code of the employee being replaced
  5. Substitution Cause Code: the code describing the reason for the substitution
  6. Choose Save.
  7. To review substitutions for a contract, select the contract and choose Substitution from the navigation bar.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The substitution contract is linked to the replaced employee and shows the substitution cause.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution Replaced employee has no active contract The replaced employee code is incorrect or has no current contract Verify the replaced employee number

docs.title: Process Bulk Contract Changes in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure when you need to modify contract conditions (work center, schedule, category) or terminate contracts for multiple workers simultaneously. The process reads changes from an Excel file, closes current contracts at a specified date, and creates new contract periods with the updated values.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• An Excel file with at least an Employee No. column and columns with the fields to modify (using the field captions from the contracts page)
  • The employees listed in the Excel have active contracts at the change date

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Choose Bulk Contract Changes from the action bar (Process section).
  3. Select the Action:
  4. Modification: closes contracts and creates new periods with the changes
  5. Leave: terminates the contracts with a leave cause
  6. For modification:
  7. In the Change Date field, enter the date when the new period starts.
  8. For leave:
  9. In the Leave Date field, enter the termination date.
  10. In the Leave Cause Code field, enter the corresponding code.
  11. Optionally, configure Notify Affiliation to automatically generate Social Security movements (Registration, Registration and Leave, Variation, or Leave).
  12. In the file import section, choose Assistant to select the Excel file, then select the worksheet to process.
  13. Choose OK to execute.
  14. The system processes each row: for modifications it closes the current contract and creates a new one with the Excel values; for leave it terminates the contract.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: Contracts for the employees listed in the Excel file have been split at the change date. New contract periods exist with the updated conditions. If requested, the corresponding affiliation movements have been generated.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution Excel does not have Employee No. column The header row does not match field captions Verify the Excel header uses the exact field names Contract already terminated before change date The employee has no active contract at the specified date Verify the contract is active at the change date Contract overlap A contract already starts on the change date Review existing contracts for the employee

docs.title: Register Contracts and Extensions with SEPE in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure to electronically communicate contract operations to SEPE (Spanish Public Employment Service) through the NetContrata integration. You can register new contracts, extensions, transformations, seasonal worker call-ups, and cancellations both individually and in bulk.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The NetContrata integration must be active (Online Office actions must be visible in the contracts list)
  • The contract must have complete data required by SEPE

docs.title: Individual operations
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Select the contract you want to register.
  3. In the action bar, under the Online Office group:
  4. Queries: Get Contract ID, Get Fingerprint, Get Contract Data, Query Cancellations, List Communicated Contracts
  5. For List Communicated Contracts: select a period (Current Month, Current Quarter, Current Year, or Previous Year)
  6. Modifications: Cancel Contract Movement, Contribution Group Variation, Remote Work Agreement
  7. Subrogations: Contract Subrogation, Company Subrogation
  8. The system sends the request to NetContrata and displays the result.

docs.title: Bulk operations
docs.text:
1. Select multiple contracts in the list (Ctrl+Click or Shift+Click).
  2. In the action bar, under the Bulk SEPE group:
  3. Register Contract (bulk): mass contract registration
  4. Register Extension (bulk): mass extension registration
  5. Register Transformation (bulk): mass contract type transformation
  6. Register Call-up (bulk): mass seasonal worker call-up
  7. The system processes each selected contract and sends the requests to NetContrata.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: Requests have been sent to NetContrata. Results can be reviewed in the NetContrata request log.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution Online Office actions are not visible The NetContrata integration is not configured Set up the integration in OMNE NetContrata Config NetContrata request error Contract data is incomplete for the operation type Review the contract data and complete all required fields

docs.title: Set Up the Contracts Module in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Before you can create and manage employment contracts, you must configure contract types, print models, and optional external integrations.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Employees (perceptors) are registered with ID number, name, and contribution unit assigned
  • Contribution units have social security account numbers (CCC) and regime configured
  • Labor agreements have active categories and vacation pay number defined
  • Contribution types exist for the current period
  • Perception schemes are linked to labor agreement categories

docs.title: Step 1: Maintain contract types catalog
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contract Types", and choose the related link.
  2. Choose New to create a contract type.
  3. Fill in the required fields:
  4. Contract Key: 3-character code per legislation (for example, "100", "401", "502")
  5. Contract Type: description (for example, "Permanent ordinary")
  6. Decree: legal reference
  7. Configure the characteristics:
  8. Enable Permanent if the contract has no maximum duration
  9. Enable Part-Time if it allows part-time work
  10. Enable Training if it is a training contract
  11. Enable Seasonal if applicable
  12. Define durations:
  13. Maximum Time: maximum legal duration (for example, "3Y" for 3 years)
  14. Minimum Time: mandatory minimum duration
  15. Extension Minimum: minimum duration for each extension
  16. Configure contribution percentages (common contingencies, unemployment, occupational accident).

docs.title: Step 2: Configure print models
docs.text:
1. From the Contract Types list, select a contract type.
  2. Choose Print Models from the action bar.
  3. Verify that at least one model of type CONTRACT exists.
  4. If needed, create a model and link a valid report. Optionally assign a language.

docs.title: Step 3: Configure subsidies by contract type
docs.text:
1. From the Contract Types list, select a subsidized type.
  2. Choose Subsidies from the action bar.
  3. Verify each subsidy has a valid code, grant date, and correct percentage tiers.

docs.title: Step 4: Verify NetContrata integration (optional)
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "OMNE NetContrata Config", and choose the related link.
  2. Verify the integration is active and credentials are configured.
  3. When active, the Online Office actions become visible in the contracts list.

docs.title: Step 5: Verify Attendance Control GT+ integration (optional)
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Attendance Ctrl. Setup", and choose the related link.
  2. Verify a configuration record exists.
  3. When configured, the Send GT sequence action becomes available in the contracts list.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: Contract types are defined with correct durations, contribution rates, and print models. Optional integrations are active and their actions are visible.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Contracts overview
  • Create a contract

docs.title: Terminate an Employment Contract in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure when a worker leaves the company due to contract expiration, dismissal, voluntary leave, or any other cause. Terminating the contract triggers the calculation of pending vacation days and enables generating the AFI leave movement.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The contract is active (Terminated = No)
  • The leave date and leave cause code are known

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Select the contract to terminate and choose Card from the action bar to open the contract card.
  3. In the Company Leave field, enter the leave date.
  4. The system sets Terminated = Yes automatically.
  5. If there are active extensions, end dates are propagated.
  6. The system calculates Pending Vacation Days based on seniority, labor agreement vacation configuration, and incidents (vacations taken, strikes, suspensions).
  7. In the Leave Cause Code field, enter the corresponding cause.
  8. Review the Pending Vacation Days field to verify the calculated days.
  9. Review the Pending Vacation Payment field to verify whether days are paid as severance or prorated.
  10. Choose Save.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The contract shows Terminated = Yes with the leave date and calculated pending vacation days. The employee's data is updated to reflect the termination.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution Leave date before start date The leave date is earlier than the contract start Correct the leave date Payrolls exist after the leave date There are calculated payrolls after the specified date Cancel the payrolls after the leave date first Leave cause code required for AFI leave Attempting to generate AFI leave without a cause code Fill in the Leave Cause Code field first

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Generate AFI movements
  • Create a contract
  • Troubleshooting contracts

docs.title: Troubleshooting Contracts in Omne RH Payroll
Cannot modify the contract key
docs.text:
Symptom: The system shows an error or blocks editing the Contract Key field.

Cause: The contract has linked extensions. The system blocks this change to maintain duration validation consistency.

Solution: 1. Open the extensions list for the contract (choose Extensions from the contract). 2. Delete extensions in reverse order (last to first). 3. Return to the contract card and modify the Contract Key. 4. Recreate extensions if needed.

docs.title: Cannot create an extension - "This contract cannot be extended"
docs.text:
Symptom: The system displays an error when trying to create an extension.

Cause: Either the contract is marked as Terminated = Yes, or it is already marked as Extended = Yes.

Solution: - If Terminated = Yes: the contract is closed. Create a new contract instead. - If Extended = Yes: an extension already exists. Create the next extension from the most recent extended contract, not the original.

docs.title: Extension duration exceeds maximum
docs.text:
Symptom: The system shows an error about exceeding maximum time when entering an extension duration.

Cause: The extension end date exceeds the Maximum Time defined in the contract type, calculated from the start date of the first contract in the series.

Solution: 1. Check the Start Date of the first contract in the employee's series for that key. 2. Look up the Maximum Time in the contract types catalog. 3. Calculate the maximum allowed date: first contract start date + maximum time. 4. Adjust the extension duration so the end date stays within this limit. 5. If the worker must continue beyond the maximum, consider converting to a permanent contract.

docs.title: Online Office (NetContrata) actions are not visible
docs.text:
Symptom: The contracts list does not show the Online Office action group.

Cause: The NetContrata integration is not configured or not active.

Solution: 1. Choose the search icon, enter "OMNE NetContrata Config", and choose the related link. 2. Verify a configuration record exists. 3. Confirm the integration is marked as active. 4. Verify credentials and connection endpoint. 5. Close and reopen the contracts list.

docs.title: Cannot generate AFI leave - missing required data
docs.text:
Symptom: The system shows an error when choosing Create AFI Leave.

Cause: The Company Leave field or Leave Cause Code field is empty.

Solution: 1. Open the contract card. 2. Fill in the Company Leave field with the leave date. 3. Fill in the Leave Cause Code field. 4. Choose Save. 5. Return to the contracts list and retry Create AFI Leave.

docs.title: Print model not found when printing a contract
docs.text:
Symptom: The system shows an error that no print model is available.

Cause: No print model is assigned for the contract type, document type (CONTRACT or ANNEX), and optionally the employee's language.

Solution: 1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contract Types", and choose the related link. 2. Select the contract type that failed. 3. Choose Print Models from the action bar. 4. Verify at least one model of type CONTRACT exists. 5. If missing, create one and link a valid report.

docs.title: Cannot delete a contract - payrolls exist
docs.text:
Symptom: The system shows an error about existing calculated payrolls when trying to delete.

Cause: Calculated payrolls exist for the employee in the contract period.

Solution: 1. Identify the calculated payrolls for the employee. 2. Cancel the payrolls from the Payroll Calculation module. 3. Retry the contract deletion.

Note: Deleting a contract also removes associated substitutions, subsidies, perception schemes, and work calendar in cascade.

docs.title: Employee data not updated after contract modification
docs.text:
Symptom: After modifying contract fields, the employee card does not reflect the changes.

Cause: The contract-to-employee synchronization runs on the OnModify trigger. If modification was done externally or an error occurred, data may be out of sync.

Solution: 1. Open the contract card. 2. Make a minor change (for example, modify and restore a field value). 3. Choose Save to force the OnModify trigger to execute. 4. Verify that employee data is now updated.

docs.title: Extensions cannot be deleted - order error
docs.text:
Symptom: The system shows an error when trying to delete an extension.

Cause: Extensions must be deleted in reverse order (last to first) to maintain date consistency.

Solution: 1. Identify the last extension (highest Extension No.). 2. Delete it first. 3. Continue deleting from highest to lowest number until you reach the one to remove. 4. If you only need to close an extension without deleting it, set Extension Finalized = Yes instead.

docs.text:

  • Set up the Contracts module

docs.title: View Contract Reports in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use these reports to get listings and analysis of contracts including current contracts, upcoming expirations, and active substitutions. These reports help with operational follow-up and renewal planning.

docs.title: Contract listing report
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Choose Contracts from the action bar (Reports section).
  3. On the request page, apply filters for company, employee, contribution unit, category, contract key, start date, terminated status, or subsidized status.
  4. Choose Print or Preview.
  5. The report shows contracts with their associated extensions and subsidies.

docs.title: Contract expirations report
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Choose Contract Expirations from the action bar (Reports section).
  3. On the request page:
  4. Enable Contract Expiration to find expiring contracts
  5. Enable Trial Period End to include trial period expirations
  6. In Expiration From and Expiration To, enter the date range of interest
  7. Choose Print or Preview.
  8. The report shows contracts and extensions with end dates within the specified range.

docs.title: Substitution report
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contracts", and choose the related link.
  2. Choose Contract Substitutions from the action bar (Reports section).
  3. On the request page, enter the Start Period (the End Period is automatically set to one calendar month).
  4. Choose Print or Preview.
  5. The report cross-references substitute contracts with replaced contracts and the replaced employee's incidents.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: A printable or on-screen report with the requested information is generated.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text: Error Cause Solution Empty report Filters are too restrictive or no contracts match the criteria Broaden the filters or verify data exists in the selected range End period before start period The end date was entered before the start date Correct the period dates

docs.title: Employees (Payroll) Overview in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: The Employees (Payroll) module is the central master record for all workers who receive payroll in Omne RH. It stores identification, organizational assignment, tax data, bank details, and contact information for each employee.

docs.title: Key capabilities
docs.text:
• Complete registration: Records personal data, identification documents (NIF/NIE), Social Security affiliation number, address, and contact information.
  • Contractual and organizational assignment: Links each employee to a contribution unit, work center, labor agreement, professional category, contribution regime, and perception scheme.
  • Tax and bank data: Maintains income tax withholding percentage, family situation for tax purposes, bank accounts for salary payment, and deduction settings.
  • Data validation: Runs automatic integrity checks (NIF, affiliation number, additional data, banks, contracts) to ensure each employee is ready for payroll calculation.

docs.title: Main pages
docs.text: Page Purpose Employee List View, search, and manage all employees Employee Card Full master data for a single employee Complementary Data Extended personal data, disability, portal, and attendance settings My Employees Personal favorites list for quick access

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
Each employee record is divided into two main pages:

  • The Employee Card contains the essential data for payroll: identification, hiring, income tax, and accounting.
  • The Complementary Data page extends the information with personal details (birth date, marital status, disability), alternative payment data, foreign worker permits, and integration settings for the employee portal and attendance control.

A creation wizard guides users through completing all mandatory data blocks (complementary data, income tax, bank accounts, and contract) when registering a new employee.

docs.title: Related modules
docs.text:
• Contracts — Each employee must have at least one contract for payroll calculation.
  • Payroll Calculation — Uses employee data as the basis for calculation.
  • Income Tax — Withholding percentage and family situation determine tax deductions.
  • Social Security Contributions — Contribution group, regime, and unit define contribution bases and rates.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Set Up Employees (Payroll)
  • Create a New Employee
  • Validate Employee Data

docs.title: Complete Employee Data with the Creation Wizard in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: After creating an employee, the creation wizard guides you through four mandatory data blocks: complementary personal data, income tax configuration, bank accounts, and labor contract.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The employee is registered with at least name, surname, and document number.
  • You have the worker's date of birth.
  • You know the bank details (IBAN) for salary payment.
  • You know the contract details (start date, contribution unit, category).

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Employee List", and choose the related link. Select the employee and open the card.
  2. Choose the Creation Wizard action. The system opens each data block sequentially.

docs.title: Complementary data
docs.text:
1. The Complementary Data page opens. Enter the Date of Birth, select Gender and Marital Status.
  2. If applicable, enter the Disability Percentage and Disability Type.
  3. Choose Save and close the page.

docs.title: Income tax data
docs.text:
1. The Income Tax Information page opens. Review the Family Situation and complete spouse data if applicable.
  2. Verify dependents (children) information if the family situation is "Unmarried with children."
  3. Choose Save and close the page.

docs.title: Bank accounts
docs.text:
1. The Employee Banks list opens. Choose New to create a bank record.
  2. Enter the IBAN and the SWIFT Code.
  3. Verify the Bank Payment Type is set to Resto (main payment account).
  4. Choose Save and close the list.

docs.title: Contract
docs.text:
1. The Contract Card opens. Enter the Start Date.
  2. Select the Contribution Unit and Professional Category.
  3. Complete the remaining mandatory contract fields.
  4. Choose Save and close the card.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: When you return to the Employee Card, the Errors field should be empty or show only minor warnings. The Hiring section fields (contribution unit, agreement, category, contribution group, regime) are updated from the contract data.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Create a New Employee
  • Validate Employee Data

docs.title: Create a New Employee in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Use this procedure when a new worker joins the company and you need to register their master data in the payroll system.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The worker's contribution unit is set up.
  • The applicable labor agreement is configured with its categories.
  • You have the worker's NIF/NIE document.
  • You have the worker's Social Security affiliation number (NAF).

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Employee List", and choose the related link.
  2. Choose New to create a new employee record. The system assigns a number automatically.
  3. Enter the First Name, First Surname, and Second Surname. The Full Name field is filled automatically.
  4. Select the Document Type (NIF, NIE, or Passport).
  5. Enter the Document number. The system validates the check digit automatically.
  6. Enter the Affiliation No. (NAF). The system validates the format and check digit.
  7. In the address section, select the street type in S.C., then enter Street, Number, Floor, and Door.
  8. Enter the Postal Code. The system fills in City, Province, and Municipality Code automatically.
  9. Enter the phone number and email address in the Communication section.
  10. In the P.I.T. (Income Tax) section, enter the Income Tax % if known and select the Tax Administration.
  11. Choose Save.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The employee appears in the Employee List with an assigned number. The Errors field may show warnings if mandatory data is still missing (additional data, banks, contract). Complete these using the creation wizard.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Complete Employee Data with the Creation Wizard
  • Validate Employee Data

docs.title: FAQ for Employees (Payroll) in Omne RH Payroll
How do I know if an employee has all mandatory data filled in?
docs.text:
Open the Employee Card. At the bottom, the Errors field shows the first detected problem in red. Choose the field to see the full error list. If the field is empty, all minimum required data is filled in.

You can also run bulk validation from the Employee List using the Validate Employees action.

docs.title: Can I change the affiliation number (NAF) for an employee who has payrolls?
docs.text: No. The system blocks NAF changes for employees with calculated payrolls to prevent inconsistencies in Social Security files. Contact technical support if you need to correct an incorrect NAF.

docs.title: What is the difference between the Employee Card and Complementary Data?
docs.text:
The Employee Card contains essential payroll data: identification, address, hiring, income tax, and accounting. The Complementary Data page extends the record with personal details (date of birth, marital status, disability), alternative payment data, foreign worker permits, and settings for the employee portal and attendance control.

Access Complementary Data from the Employee Card using the Complementary Data action.

docs.title: What does the creation wizard do?
docs.text:
The creation wizard opens four pages sequentially to complete mandatory data for a new employee:

  1. Complementary Data — Creates the record and opens the page if it does not exist or is incomplete.
  2. Income Tax Data — Creates an initial tax record and opens the page if it does not exist.
  3. Employee Banks — Opens the bank list if no account with payment type "Resto" exists.
  4. Contract — Creates an initial contract and opens the card if none exists.

You can run the wizard at any time from the Employee Card using the Creation Wizard action.

docs.title: Can I have two employees with the same NIF?
docs.text: Yes, but the system asks for explicit confirmation. When you register an employee with a NIF that already exists for another employee, a message informs you of the existing record. If your organization has disabled duplicate control in Company Setup, this validation does not run.

docs.title: How do I change the income tax percentage?
docs.text: Open the Employee Card. In the P.I.T. section, change the Income Tax % field. If there is a tax history, the system asks for confirmation and resets historical values. Enable Fixed Income Tax % if the rate should not be recalculated automatically.

docs.title: What does it mean when "Calculate Payroll" is disabled?
docs.text: If the Calculate Payroll field is disabled, the employee is excluded from payroll calculation processes. This can happen because the associated contribution regime excludes them automatically, or because it was set manually. The employee still exists in the system but does not generate payrolls.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Validate Employee Data
  • Troubleshooting Employees (Payroll)

docs.title: Manage the My Employees List in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Each payroll user can create a personal list of frequently managed employees for quick access, without searching the full employee list.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The employees you want to add exist in the system.
  • You have access to the payroll module.

docs.title: Add employees to your list
docs.text:
1. Open the My Employees page from the payroll Role Center or workspace.
  2. In a new line, select the Employee No. field.
  3. Enter the employee code or use the lookup to find the employee.
  4. The system fills in the name and phone number automatically.
  5. Repeat for each employee you want to add.

docs.title: Open an employee from the list
docs.text:
1. Select an employee in the My Employees list.
  2. Choose the Open action (or press Enter) to go directly to the full Employee Card.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The My Employees list shows only the employees you have added. Each user sees only their own personal list. You can open any employee's full card directly from this list with a single action.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Create a New Employee
  • Employees (Payroll) Overview

docs.title: Modify Employee Data in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: When an employee's circumstances change (address, bank details, income tax percentage, personal data), update the information on the Employee Card.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The employee exists in the system.
  • You have the new data to update.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Employee List", and choose the related link. Find the employee and open the card.
  2. Modify the fields that need updating:
  3. Address: Update the street, number, floor, door, and postal code. The system refreshes city and province automatically when you change the postal code.
  4. Income Tax %: In the P.I.T. section, change the percentage value. If the employee has a tax history, the system asks for confirmation. Historical values (quota, remuneration, base) are reset.
  5. Fixed Income Tax %: Enable this field if the percentage is fixed at the worker's request.
  6. Bank accounts: Choose the Employee Banks action to add, modify, or remove bank accounts.
  7. Choose Save when prompted to confirm your changes.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The updated data is reflected on the Employee Card. If the income tax percentage was changed, the new rate applies starting from the next payroll calculation.

docs.title: Important notes
docs.text:
• The affiliation number (NAF) cannot be changed if the employee already has calculated payrolls. Contact technical support if a correction is needed.
  • If changes affect contribution or contract data, review the active contract from the Contracts action on the Employee Card.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Validate Employee Data
  • Employees (Payroll) Overview

docs.title: Set Up Employees (Payroll) in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Before registering employees, you must configure number series, duplicate controls, and ensure all required master data exists in the system.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Contribution units are set up (choose the search icon, enter "Contribution Units", and choose the related link).
  • Work centers are configured within each contribution unit.
  • Labor agreements are set up with professional categories.
  • Contribution groups and regimes are configured.
  • Tax administration offices are set up.
  • Accounting groups for payroll are defined.

docs.title: Configure the employee number series
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Payroll Setup", and choose the related link.
  2. In the Employee No. Series field, assign the number series for auto-generating employee codes.
  3. Choose Save.

docs.title: Configure duplicate employee control
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Company Setup", and choose the related link.
  2. Find the Do not control repeated employees field.
  3. Leave this option disabled (default) if you want the system to detect duplicate NIF and affiliation numbers.
  4. Choose Save.

docs.title: Configure mandatory statistical group (optional)
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Company Setup", and choose the related link.
  2. If your organization requires all employees to have a statistical group, enable the corresponding option.
  3. Choose Save.

docs.title: Configure analytical dimensions (optional)
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Payroll Setup", and choose the related link.
  2. Review the global dimension configuration (department and program).
  3. If you use additional analytical dimensions (global dimensions 3 and 4), verify they are defined.
  4. Choose Save.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: When you create a new employee from the Employee List, the system automatically assigns an employee number and allows you to fill in all required fields without configuration errors.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Create a New Employee
  • Employees (Payroll) Overview

docs.title: Terminate an Employee in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: When a worker permanently leaves the company, register the termination on the Employee Card so they are excluded from future payroll processes.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• The worker has stopped providing services.
  • You know the termination date and cause.
  • Any pending payrolls for the employee have been calculated and posted.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Employee List", and choose the related link. Find the employee and open the card.
  2. In the Hiring section, enter the Company Termination date.
  3. Select the Termination Cause Code. The system fills in the Termination Cause and Termination Reason descriptions automatically.
  4. If the employee is registered in the Employee Portal, choose the Portal User Termination action from the Portal section.
  5. If the employee is integrated with Attendance Control (GT+), verify that the integration status updates to "Pending employee termination."
  6. Confirm the changes when prompted to save.

docs.title: Result
docs.text:
• The employee appears with the termination date filled in.
  • The employee is excluded from bulk validation and payroll calculation after the termination date.
  • Portal and attendance control integrations are updated according to the termination status.

docs.title: Important notes
docs.text:
• Do not delete an employee record that has calculated payrolls. Always register a termination instead.
  • After registering the termination, generate the Social Security termination communication from the Affiliation module if applicable.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Validate Employee Data
  • Employees (Payroll) Overview

docs.title: Troubleshooting Employees (Payroll) in Omne RH Payroll
NIF/NIE check digit is incorrect
docs.text:
Symptom: When you enter the identification document, the system shows an error and does not allow saving.

Cause: The NIF or NIE number contains a typo, or the control letter does not match the calculated check digit.

Solution:

  1. Verify the document number against the worker's original document.
  2. Correct the number or control letter as indicated by the system message.
  3. If the document type is Passport, the system does not validate a check digit.

docs.title: Employee already exists with the same document or NAF
docs.text:
Symptom: When registering a new employee or changing NIF/NAF, a message indicates another employee already has the same document.

Cause: You are registering an employee with a NIF or NAF that belongs to another record.

Solution:

  1. Check whether the worker is already registered under a different employee number.
  2. If it is an unintended duplicate, correct the NIF or NAF.
  3. If it is a legitimate situation (for example, rehiring), confirm the duplicate when prompted.
  4. To enable or disable duplicate control, go to Company Setup and check the Do not control repeated employees field.

docs.title: Cannot change the NAF because payrolls exist
docs.text:
Symptom: When you try to change the affiliation number, the system blocks the modification.

Cause: The employee has calculated payrolls with the current NAF. The system blocks changes to maintain Social Security file consistency.

Solution:

  1. If few payrolls exist, consult technical support about canceling payrolls, correcting the NAF, and recalculating.
  2. If the NAF change is legitimate (new affiliation number), it may be necessary to terminate the current employee and create a new one with the correct NAF.
  3. Contact technical support for the recommended approach.

docs.title: Missing mandatory data (additional data, income tax, banks, or contract)
docs.text:
Symptom: The Errors field on the Employee Card shows messages about missing data blocks.

Cause: The employee was registered but not all mandatory data blocks were completed.

Solution:

  1. Open the Employee Card.
  2. Choose the Creation Wizard action.
  3. The wizard opens each incomplete data block sequentially: complementary data, income tax, banks, and contract.
  4. Complete all requested data in each page.
  5. Verify the Errors field is empty when finished.

docs.title: Work permit is expiring or has expired
docs.text:
Symptom: Validation shows a warning about work permit validity for a foreign worker.

Cause: The work authorization expiry date is within 15 days or has already passed.

Solution:

  1. Open the employee's Complementary Data (from the card, choose the Complementary Data action).
  2. In the Foreign Workers section, check the Work Authorization Validity field.
  3. If the permit has been renewed, update the date with the new validity.
  4. If not renewed, coordinate renewal with the appropriate department.

docs.title: Income tax family situation is inconsistent with dependents
docs.text:
Symptom: Validation shows an error that the family situation "Unmarried with children" is inconsistent with dependent records.

Cause: The family situation is set to "Unmarried with children" but no qualifying dependent (child under 25 without income or with disability) is registered.

Solution:

  1. Open the employee's Dependents (from the card, choose the Dependents action).
  2. Verify at least one dependent is registered as a qualifying child.
  3. If the family situation is incorrect, change it in the income tax data.

docs.title: Only one bank with payment type Resto is allowed
docs.text:
Symptom: Validation shows an error that multiple banks have the "Resto" payment type.

Cause: Two or more bank accounts are configured with the "Resto" (main payment) type. Only one is allowed.

Solution:

  1. Open Employee Banks from the Employee Card.
  2. Identify accounts with payment type "Resto."
  3. Change the type of extra accounts to another type, or remove unused accounts.
  4. Keep only one account with type "Resto."

docs.title: When to contact technical support
docs.text:
Contact support if:

  • You need to change the NAF for an employee with calculated payrolls.
  • Validation errors cannot be resolved with available data.
  • You need to delete an employee that has associated payrolls.
  • There are integration issues with the employee portal or attendance control.
  • Inconsistencies exist between employee data and official Social Security files.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Validate Employee Data

docs.title: Validate Employee Data in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: Before calculating payroll, verify that all mandatory employee data is correctly filled in. You can validate a single employee or run a bulk validation for all active employees.

docs.text: Use the history actions on the Employee Card to consult past payroll movements, calculated payrolls, contribution periods, provisions, or statistics.

docs.title: Income Tax Withholding (IRPF) in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text:
The Income Tax module manages the complete lifecycle of personal income tax withholdings in payroll: from calculating the withholding percentage for each employee, through recording retention movements, to generating electronic tax declarations (models 111, 190, 216, 296, and 345).

The module supports both the state tax regime (AEAT) and regional regimes (Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa, Alava, Navarra), automatically applying the corresponding regulations based on the tax administration assigned to each work center.

docs.title: Key concepts
docs.text:
• Withholding percentage: The percentage deducted from the employee's gross salary as income tax, calculated according to current tax regulations considering income, family situation, disability, and applicable deductions.
  • Form 145: The employee's communication to the company with personal and family data that affects the income tax calculation (family status, dependents, disability, mortgage).
  • Withholding percentage change journal: A workspace where the system calculates proposed new percentages for each employee, compares them with current rates, and applies changes in bulk or selectively.
  • Income tax journal: Records income tax movements for payments that do not come directly from payroll (professional invoices, manual adjustments).
  • Settlements: Periodic (monthly or quarterly) and annual tax declarations summarizing withholdings for electronic filing.

docs.title: Tax declaration models
docs.text: Model Frequency Content 111 Monthly Withholdings and payments on account (large companies) 111T Quarterly Withholdings and payments on account (SMEs) 190 Annual Annual summary of withholdings per employee 216 Quarterly Non-resident withholdings 296 Annual Annual summary of non-resident withholdings 345 Annual Pension plans and funds

docs.title: Calculate Withholding Percentage Proposals in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: At the start of each fiscal year, or when an employee's personal circumstances change, you must recalculate the income tax withholding percentage. The system generates a proposal that you can review and apply in bulk or selectively.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• IRPF configuration updated for the fiscal year (parameters and retention tables)
  • Form 145 data recorded for employees
  • Tax administration assigned to each work center

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Cambios % Reten.IRPF", and choose the related link.
  2. Set the Year field to the fiscal year (for example, 2025).
  3. Choose the Calculate proposal action.
  4. The system runs the calculation engine for each employee
  5. It determines the tax administration (state or regional) and applies the corresponding regulations
  6. It calculates: income, work reductions, personal minimum, family minimum, gross quota, and resulting withholding percentage
  7. Review the journal columns:
  8. Proposed %: New percentage calculated by the system
  9. Current %: Active percentage for the employee
  10. Variation: Difference between proposed and current
  11. Fixed % current: Indicates whether the employee requested a fixed percentage via Form 145
  12. To apply to all employees: choose the Change all action.
  13. To apply to selected employees only:
  14. Choose Mark line on each desired employee (or Mark all)
  15. Choose the Change marked action.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The employees now have their withholding percentage updated. A record is created in the retention history with all calculation data. Employees with a fixed percentage that differs from the proposal receive a confirmation dialog before the change is applied.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Recalculate withholding for specific employees
  • Register Form 145 data for an employee
  • Troubleshooting income tax

docs.title: Cancel an Income Tax Settlement in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: If you detect an error in a generated settlement (incorrect amounts, wrong period, need to file a supplementary), you must cancel it before regenerating. If the settlement was already submitted to the tax authority, generate a supplementary settlement instead.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• An existing settlement that needs correction
  • The settlement has not been submitted to AEAT (if already submitted, use a supplementary settlement)

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Liquidaciones IRPF", and choose the related link.
  2. Locate the settlement to cancel.
  3. Choose the Cancel action.
  4. Confirm when the system asks: "Do you confirm you want to cancel the settlement?"
  5. Correct the source data (journal entries, employees, payrolls).
  6. Regenerate the settlement.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The settlement is marked as canceled. The accumulated amounts are reversed. You can now regenerate the settlement with corrected data.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Generate periodic settlement model 111
  • Troubleshooting income tax

docs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Income Tax in Omne RH Payroll
What is the difference between "Change all" and "Change marked" when applying proposals?
docs.text:
• Change all applies the proposed percentage to all lines for the year. Use it at the start of a fiscal year when the entire proposal is reviewed and approved.
  • Change marked applies only to manually marked lines. Use it for selective changes: only employees with significant variation, or after individual corrections.

In both cases, if an employee has a fixed percentage different from the proposal, the system asks for confirmation before modifying it.

docs.title: What happens if an employee has a fixed percentage and the proposal calculates a different one?
docs.text:
When the employee has the "Fixed % current" field active, it means they requested a fixed percentage via Form 145 (above the legal minimum). The system handles this differently:

  • If the fixed % is higher than proposed: the system asks whether you want to change it.
  • If the fixed % is lower than proposed: the system also asks, because the fixed rate might be outdated.

The fixed percentage is a voluntary request from the employee and cannot be modified automatically without verification.

docs.title: Why does the system calculate different percentages for two employees with the same salary?
docs.text:
The withholding percentage depends on multiple factors beyond salary:

  • Family situation (with dependent spouse, without spouse, single with children)
  • Number and age of children (under 3 have additional reductions)
  • Disability of the employee or dependents
  • Tax administration (state vs. regional with different regulations)
  • Contract type (contracts under 1 year have a different minimum)
  • Special circumstances (geographic mobility, Ceuta/Melilla, housing mortgage)

All this data comes from the Form 145 registered for each employee.

docs.title: When should I load retention tables for a new year?
docs.text:
Load tables and configuration parameters at the start of each fiscal year, when new regulatory values are published in the official gazette (BOE). You do not need to delete the previous year's configuration; create a new one for the incoming year.

For regional tax authorities, values are published in their respective official bulletins and may have different dates and amounts.

docs.title: What is the difference between the IRPF journal and the percentage change journal?
docs.text:
Journal Purpose Result IRPF Journal Record withholding movements external to payroll Payroll headers of type IRPF Percentage change journal Calculate and apply new withholding percentages Update of the IRPF % in the employee card

They are complementary tools: one records amounts, the other manages percentages.

docs.title: How does the calculation work for regional tax authority employees?
docs.text: The calculation engine automatically detects the regional authority through the tax administration assigned to the employee's work center. Each territory (Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa, Alava, Navarra) has its own retention tables, reductions, and minimums. You must load IRPF configuration and retention tables for each regional authority in use.

docs.title: What is a "Calculation Type" and when is each value used?
docs.text:
Calculation Type When to use Initial First proposal of the year, without previous payroll data for the fiscal year Regularization Recalculation due to mid-year circumstance changes With Payrolls Recalculation considering payrolls already calculated in the year Without Pending Remuneration Calculation without considering pending remunerations Annual Final calculation at year-end close

The calculation type is selected in the percentage change journal and affects how the engine estimates the employee's income.
