docs.title: Troubleshoot Social Security Files in Omne RH Payroll
TC2 file does not include some employees
Possible causes
docs.text:
• The employee does not have a posted payroll for the period.
  • The payroll has the Excluded from Contribution field marked.
  • The employee is not assigned to the filtered contribution unit.
  • The employee's contribution regime does not match the filter.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Payroll Headers", and verify the employee has a payroll for the period.
  2. If the payroll exists, check the Excluded from Contribution field and unmark it if the employee should contribute.
  3. Verify the employee's contribution unit and regime assignment match the filters used.

docs.title: Error receiving CRETA files — Directory not found
Possible causes
docs.text:
• The directory path does not exist or is misspelled.
  • The user does not have read permissions on the folder.
  • The telematic site configuration is incorrect.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
1. Verify the path exists in the file system.
  2. Check folder permissions for the Business Central service account.
  3. Choose the search icon, enter "Telematic Sites", and verify the site code and directory path match.

docs.title: CRETA segments show Error status with code I001
Possible causes
docs.text:
• Recent employee registrations do not yet have internal segments.
  • Data migration was incomplete.
  • The period or start date does not match exactly.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Contribution Segments", and filter by Status = "Error" and Code = "I001".
  2. For each segment, verify if an internal segment exists with the same CCC, NAF, and start date.
  3. If it does not exist, create the internal segment manually.
  4. Re-run validation.

docs.title: Possible causes
docs.text:
• Complementary payrolls with negative retroactive adjustments.
  • Returns or regularizations exceed the positive amount for the period.
  • Payroll calculation errors.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
1. Run the CRA Concepts List report to identify affected concepts.
  2. Review payrolls for the period for those concepts.
  3. Either correct the payroll, generate a complementary liquidation, or defer to the next period if the negative is correct.

docs.title: Possible causes
docs.text:
• The FLC telematic site is not configured or the API Key has expired.
  • Network connectivity to the TGSS service is unavailable.
  • Required data on the contribution unit is incomplete.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Telematic Sites", and verify the FLC site has a valid API Key and URL.
  2. Test network connectivity to the service URL.
  3. Verify the contribution unit has CCC, CIF, and period data filled.
  4. If the TGSS service is under maintenance, retry later.

docs.title: Possible causes
docs.text:
• No qualifying incidents exist for the filtered employees.
  • Incident types are not recognized (must be ERE, illness, accident, maternity, or vacation).
  • The company filter is incorrect.
  • For termination prior transmission, contracts lack the Termination Cause Code.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Incidents", and verify records exist for the employees.
  2. Check that incident types match the expected categories.
  3. For termination ERE, verify contracts have the termination cause code filled.
  4. Broaden filters if they are too restrictive (for example, remove the employee filter).

docs.title: Affiliation records not updated after batch file generation
Possible causes
docs.text:
• The process was interrupted before completing the update.
  • No records matched the filter criteria.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
1. Verify that records have the Send Date filled and Sent Date empty.
  2. Re-run the process. The system generates a new file without creating duplicate data in the affiliation records.

docs.text:
• Set up Social Security Files
  • FAQ
  • Social Security Files overview

docs.title: Validate CRETA Payrolls in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: After exchanging CRETA data, validate that the payroll concept amounts calculated by your system match the values recalculated by TGSS. Any discrepancies must be investigated and resolved.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• CRETA data exchange must be completed (files requested, received, and segments validated).
  • Payrolls must be calculated for the period being validated.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Choose the search icon, enter "Validate CRETA Payrolls", and choose the related link.
  2. On the request page, set the filters:
  3. Employee No.: Select the employee(s) to validate.
  4. Period: Select the period.
  5. Operation Type: Select the payroll type.
  6. Choose OK to generate the validation report.
  7. Review the comparison matrix:
  8. Original column: Amount calculated by your system.
  9. New column: Amount returned by TGSS.
  10. Difference column: If zero, the concept is correct.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: All concepts should show a difference of zero. Any non-zero difference indicates a discrepancy that must be investigated in contribution bases, contribution rates, or segment specifications.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Validate CRETA segments
  • Generate CRETA bases file
  • Generate TC2 file

docs.title: Validate CRETA Segments in Omne RH Payroll
docs.text: After receiving TyT files from TGSS, validate that the contribution segments match your internal records. Resolve all discrepancies before submitting contribution bases.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text: • CRETA TyT files must have been received and loaded into the system.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Validation runs automatically when TyT files are received.
  2. To review results, choose the search icon, enter "Contribution Segments", and choose the related link.
  3. Filter by Status = "Error" to see discrepancies.
  4. Review the Error Code on each erroneous segment to identify the issue.
  5. Correct the discrepancy in the internal data.
  6. Re-run validation until all segments show status "Validated".

docs.title: Error codes reference
docs.text: Code Meaning Action I001 Segment does not exist in the system Create the internal segment I002 Contribution unit (CCC) does not match Review CCC assignment I003 Contract code is different Correct the contract I004 Contribution group is different Review assigned group I005 Occupation code is different Update occupation code I006 Part-time percentage does not match Review part-time configuration I009 End date is different Correct the end date

docs.title: Result
docs.text: All segments must reach "Validated" status before you can submit contribution bases to TGSS. No segments should remain in "Error" status.
